candidate.definition_en: A state in which supreme power is held by the people and their elected representatives, rather than by a monarch.
candidate.explanation_ar: دولة نظام الحكم فيها جمهوري، يعني الشعب بيختار الرئيس والممثلين بتوعه، مش ملكية.

senses.definition_en: A state in which supreme power is held by the people and their elected representatives, rather than by a monarch.
senses.definition_ar: دولة نظام الحكم فيها جمهوري، وتكون السلطة فيها للشعب وممثليه المنتخبين لا لملك.
examples: The president of the republic gave a speech.
They fought to establish a republic.
The transition from monarchy to republic was bloody.
The president of the republic gave a speech.
They fought to establish a republic.
The transition from monarchy to republic was bloody.
candidate.mnemonic: زي 'Republic'.. 'جمهورية'.. 'Public' يعني عامة الشعب، فالـ 'Republic' حكم الشعب.
